# Document templates

Copy these, keep the headings. The rules for where each kind of fact goes are in [GAME_SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS.md](../GAME_SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS.md), section 7.

| Template | Copy to |
|---|---|
| [GAME_README.md](GAME_README.md) | `docs/<game>/README.md` |
| [SUPPORT_STATUS.md](../archive/templates/SUPPORT_STATUS.md) | `docs/<game>/SUPPORT_STATUS.md` |
| [SCRIPT_MAP.md](SCRIPT_MAP.md) | `docs/<game>/<GAME>_SCRIPT_MAP.md` |
| [EVIDENCE_RECORD.md](EVIDENCE_RECORD.md) | `.verification/<game>-<stage>-<yyyymmdd>/README.md` |
